name: toro-kid-money
description: TŌRO sub-plugin — the viral wedge. Chore-and-allowance agent for NZ whānau. Tracks jobs, pays kids directly into their NZ bank account via CDR payment initiation, splits each payment three ways (Spend / Save / Give), and turns the weekly settle-up into something worth filming. Phase 1 ships pre-CDR with manual-transfer prompts; Phase 2 enables live payments once Assembl Ltd is an accredited requestor under the Customer and Product Data Act 2025.
